caption: The same uncut concrete plaza shot continues smoothly. The same young skateboarder turns back to face the camera and returns to the initial stance. His shoulder-length curly dark hair, tan skin, narrow face, relaxed smile, faded red hoodie with the small white star patch, loose black cargo pants, white high-top sneakers, and teal skateboard with orange wheels remain consistent. Smooth continuous motion, no camera cut, late afternoon sunlight, urban plaza background.
